description: Source-scoped additional publications, benchmarks, software, datasets, and released weights. Some entries describe supporting artefacts of papers; do not count all as independent papers.

records.title: Ketaba-OCR at AR-MS NakbaNLP 2026
records.data: Omar Al-Saleh Memoir; 15,962 train + 2,095 dev-test final training; 2,671 blind
records.framework: specialized HTR plus QLoRA/DoRA/RSLoRA and ensemble
records.architecture: Qwen2.5-VL based Arabic-English handwritten OCR backbone
records.baselines: organizer baseline, specialized HTR, Qari and generic VLM models
records.experimental_conditions: QLoRA 4-bit NF4, r32 alpha64, lr2e-5, batch1 accum4, 1 epoch

records.title: TextDiffuser: Diffusion Models as Text Painters
records.input: text prompt and optional text template
records.architecture: Transformer layout generator plus image diffusion model
records.metrics: OCR and image/text quality; precise figures not checked
records.experimental_conditions: NeurIPS 2023 main track; full hyperparameters pending

records.title: GlyphControl: Glyph Conditional Control for Visual Text Generation
records.metrics: OCR, CLIP, FID; numbers not extracted

records.title: VidSketch: Hand-drawn Sketch-Driven Video Generation with Diffusion Control
records.data: author-collected small video sets, 8-12 clips per action category
records.framework: level-based sketch control and TempSpatial attention
records.architecture: video diffusion with inflated T2I adapter
records.metrics: video text/sketch alignment and visual quality; numeric table pending
records.experimental_conditions: author repo reports RTX4090 training for some action categories

records.title: VideoSketcher: Video Models Prior Enable Versatile Sequential Sketch Generation
records.input: text drawing plan and optional brush reference image
records.data: synthetic primitives and 7 real artist sketch examples for stage2
records.framework: two-stage LoRA plus LLM planning and AR distillation
records.metrics: not independently extracted from paper table
records.experimental_conditions: README examples: 480p,81 frames,50 steps/14B, A100 16min; AR 11s
records.next: read paper methods/results and pin git revision

records.title: Calligraphy Bench: Can AI Write Chinese Calligraphy?
records.input: reference image and API drawing tools
records.architecture: external multimodal agents and tldraw canvas
records.metrics: stroke recall/order on matched strokes, visual fidelity 1-5, MJ1 pairwise
records.baselines: GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6, Kimi K2.5, GLM-5
records.experimental_conditions: OpenHands/MCP tool-based; judge process trace details pending

records.title: Brush Calligraphy Stroke Segmentation Dataset (BCSS)
records.data: paper-full 1322 images/10653 strokes vs HF processed subset 1212 images
records.architecture: no generator in data release; companion Stroke-Seg paper
records.metrics: segmentation metrics from paper need lookup
records.next: audit each mask to stroke identity and normative order

records.title: Wuji Writing VAM TI2V-5B 30L 0522 0819
records.input: human egocentric reference video, robot 3-view image, prompt and 54-D state
